The '''pulse-wave rifle''' was a larger, [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] version of the [[Pulse-wave blaster|pulse-wave pistol]]. Like the pistol version, the pulse-wave rifle was able to deal more damage at close range, but was less effective at long range.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

The pulse-wave rifle cost 550 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It weighed 4 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and fired 50 shots before its [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] needed to be replaced.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

Variants of this weapon included the [[Type A pulse-wave rifle]] manufactured by [[Greff-Timms Industrial/Legends|Greff-Timms Industrial]], the [[P-301 pulse-wave sniper rifle]], the [[J-301 Pulse-Wave Saboteur]], and the [[M-110 Pulse-Wave Disruptor]].

The [[Juggernaut war droid]]s of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] used a pulse-wave rifle as their primary weapon.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />
